body:
## Summary

Docs-only. Closes out the ADR-0030 notification-platform work shipped this session (P0–P3b1 across #1434 / #1441 / #1444 / #1449 / #1453) and **hands the remaining work to a follow-up agent**.

- **ADR-0030** → `Status: Accepted`, with a new **"Implementation status & remaining work"** section:
  - a *shipped* table (P0 seams, P1 reliable delivery, P2 preference, P3a email+templates, P3b-1 quiet-hours, messaging-as-foundational startup),
  - a *remaining* breakdown: **P3b-2 digest**; the **cross-repo objectui bell cut-over + mark-read receipt write path** (the user-facing delivery, in the separate `objectui` repo) + running the data migration; incremental channels (push/webhook/Slack) + `defineTopic` + subscription fan-out + MJML + quiet-hours tz fallback; and hardening (dedup unique index, event-log retention, translations regen, the CI `@objectstack/spec` build-order flake).
- **Build spec** gets a status banner so its original §4 checklists aren't read as outstanding; points to the ADR status section + the handoff doc.

No code changes. The detailed cut-over runbook remains in `docs/handoff/adr-0030-notification-convergence.md`.
